name: sillytavern-vault
description: Encryption at rest for SillyTavern. A Storage Provider: every byte of user data, including the filenames, is ciphertext on disk.
_exports_note: Consumers importing by package name can reach the root, verification, and test-only reset hooks. The exports map describes that package-resolved surface. The fork loader imports the provider entry through `main` with `pathToFileURL`, so the map does not restrict that runtime path; keep `main` aligned with the provider entry point.
_dependencies_note: Keep runtime dependencies empty: key handling uses Node crypto and the local RFC-compliant AES-SIV implementation. Runtime dependencies execute in the process holding the data key and expand its trusted code surface. Development tools remain devDependencies.
